name: Claude Harness
description: Autonomous Plan → Work → Review cycle for Claude Code. Go-native engine with 25× faster hooks, runtime guardrails on .git/ / secrets / destructive commands, and SSOT memory — designed for solo developers ("Vibecoders") who ship full-cycle contract work.
longDescription:
Ships **21 skills**, **4 agents** and **27 hooks**.

- **Skills** (21): `agent-browser` (Browser automation through the repo agent-browser CLI), `breezing` (Team execution mode (Codex host) — backward-compatible alias for harness-work with backend selection, including opt-in Cursor worker delegation), `cc-update-review` (Quality guardrail for Claude/Codex update integration), `ci` (CI red), `cursor-ask` (Read-only delegate to cursor-agent (Composer) for questions, investigation, design discussion, and adversarial sanity checks), `cursor-do` (Delegate a single write task to Cursor Composer via cursor-companion.sh inside an isolated worktree, then Lead-review the diff…), `cursor-review` (Run a Cursor Composer review as an advisory second opinion while keeping the primary review verdict on the…), `cursor-setup` (Configure and verify the Cursor backend for Claude Code Harness), and 13 more
- **Agents** (4): `advisor` (Non-executing advisor for advisor-request.v1 in Cursor), `reviewer` (Read-only reviewer for diffs, risk, and missing tests in Cursor), `test-wiring-auditor` (変更差分に対してテスト網が追随しているかを fresh-context で監査する read-only auditor), `worker` (Scoped implementation worker for a single Plans.md task in Cursor)
- **Hooks** (27): `PreToolUse`, `PermissionRequest`, `Setup`, `SessionStart`, `SubagentStart`, `InstructionsLoaded`, `SubagentStop`, `PostToolUseFailure`, and 19 more

Installs with `claude plugin install claude-harness@claude-community` from `Chachamaru127/claude-code-harness`.
